_note: deco-mulberry album DRAFT (Nov 7): Claude's own picks, Tiffany's Nov 7 7:03pm ask ('You take them, just like you did this one'). Groups in order; 'lowres' = best photo we have is under ~800px.

groups.teal: Deep teal, so the berry pops

mats.name: Viola
mats.why: Your Mulberry pairing from October: a deep teal center for her teal bams, inside pink and plum florals on black that echo her backs.

mats.name: Caroline in Peacock
mats.why: A peacock teal center in a frame of berry and magenta blooms: her back color and her teal bams, both at full strength.

mats.name: Deco Dragon (Lagoon)
mats.why: Bam Bird Boutique's own Deco Dragon mat, in her sister color. Bam Bird shoots Mulberry tiles on it, and the gold palms glow against the teal.

mats.name: Wren
mats.why: A deep teal center, a mulberry scalloped frame and a plum paisley border. All of her colors in one mat.

mats.name: Spring Blooms Premium
mats.why: A teal center with plum, pink and gold flowers: the backs, the bams and the gold palm.

mats.name: Tiger Fans
mats.why: Plum deco fans around a jewel-tone tiger tapestry. The fan shape is pure art deco, and the plum is her back. Sold on Etsy.

mats.name: Peony Sociale Premium
mats.why: Deep teal with hot pink peonies; the pink sits right next to her berry backs.

mats.name: Deco Neoprene
mats.why: Bam Bird Boutique's teal neoprene with gold deco corners, the plain sister of the Dragon mat.

mats.name: Dark Teal Cocktail Hour
mats.why: A dark teal solid with a fine gold border. Simple, so the berry backs do the talking.

mats.name: Jade
mats.why: Oh My Mahjong's deep teal and blue botanical. The berry backs pop right off it.

mats.name: Emerald Cove Mat
mats.why: Dark teal-green watercolor with a mint edge. Moody, jewel-toned, and the opposite of berry.

mats.name: Evergreen
mats.why: Deep teal with ferns and a gold fretwork corner.

mats.name: Year of the Snake
mats.why: A deep teal ground with a pink frame; the pink bridges the teal and her berry.

mats.name: Mahj In Bloom Mat
mats.why: Deep teal with lilac and pink roses: berry-adjacent flowers on her teal.

mats.name: The Mariner
mats.why: Teal marbled paper around a deep green center. Old-library deco.

mats.name: Ocean Florals
mats.why: A deep teal field like her bams, framed in berry-pink, coral and periwinkle blooms. Found in the Nov 8 catalog check (its new 'with instructions' version); the card uses the plain mat.

mats.name: Pretty in Plum Premium
mats.why: Plum, lilac and ivory with a scalloped center: her back color, softened.

mats.name: Fall Fling Mat
mats.why: Black with pink, plum and sage flowers. The plum ties in her backs.

mats.name: Flourish Neoprene
mats.why: Plum and magenta florals around a slate center.

mats.name: Regal Bloom Neoprene
mats.why: A lilac center with a tiger, framed in dark plum florals.

mats.name: Mulberry and Sage
mats.why: Mulberry stripes around a sage center, and the same name. The sage keeps it from being berry on berry.

mats.name: Garden Party – Mulberry
mats.why: My Fair Mahjong's mulberry center with a teal edge: her back color plus her bams.

mats.name: YOTD Raspberry
mats.why: Raspberry with pink roses and a blue-teal dragon that could be her green dragon's cousin.

mats.name: Burgundy Grove
mats.why: A wine center inside an ivory floral frame. Close to her back, a little warmer.

mats.name: Gilded Peacock
mats.why: Art deco gold lines and peacock feathers on deep teal: deco on deco.

mats.name: Hawthorne
mats.why: A plum center with a navy and gold border: her berry back with her navy dots.

mats.name: Crown Jewels
mats.why: Navy with jewel-tone blooms and gold lines.

mats.name: Peacock Flair
mats.why: A deep purple circle with teal peacock feathers. The purple runs a little cooler than her berry.

mats.name: Purple & Aqua Marble
mats.why: Purple and aqua marble with gold veins.

mats.name: Plum Scallop
mats.why: Ivory with a plum scalloped border. Clean, and it lets the tiles shine.

mats.name: Petals After Dark
mats.why: Black with teal and pink petals: her teal bams and berry backs on a night sky.

mats.name: Poinsettia Party
mats.why: Holiday: a mulberry frame like her backs around a chartreuse field, with berry poinsettias and pink ornaments. Her back colour is already on the mat.

mats.name: Winter Jewel
mats.why: Holiday: a deep teal ground like her bams with a jewel snowflake in berry, coral and gold. Teal across the wheel from her berry backs.

mats.name: Yuletide
mats.why: Holiday: an emerald-and-teal plaid inside a berry-red frame with roses and lanterns. Teal for her bams, berry for her backs.
